caption: The drawing is a grayscale pencil illustration on an off-white or beige background, featuring a detailed depiction of a bonnet. The main object—the bonnet—occupies the left-central area of the composition and is shown in a three-quarter view facing right, with intricate crosshatched patterns suggesting a woven or quilted texture. The edges of the bonnet are trimmed with a decorative, scalloped lace border. There are also two long, thin ribbons hanging down from the sides, illustrated with subtle curves. On the right side of the drawing, there are two smaller diagrams labeled "FRONT" and "BACK," showing simplified front and back views of the bonnet for reference. The entire drawing is outlined by a rectangular border, and the artist’s name “P. JENNER” is written in the lower right corner. The whole composition uses fine pencil lines for detail, without any color other than the shading provided by the pencil.
